description.en:
The model ID of the media fingerprint library.

- The model ID for a text media fingerprint library is **11** (deprecated).

- The model ID for a video media fingerprint library is **12**.

- The model ID for an audio media fingerprint library is **13**.

- The model ID for an image media fingerprint library is **14** (deprecated).
The name of the media fingerprint library.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口可以新建视频、音频、图片和文本DNA库。
- 文本DNA相关接口目前仅支持华东2（上海）地域使用。
- 单个用户默认可以创建指纹库个数为 5 个，如需提高，请提交工单申请。无用指纹库可以调用 SubmitFpDBDeleteJob 接口删除。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This operation creates media fingerprint libraries for video, audio, images, and text.

- You can create text media fingerprint libraries only in the China (Shanghai) region.

- By default, each user can create up to five media fingerprint libraries. To increase the limit, submit a ticket. To delete unneeded libraries, call the `SubmitFpDBDeleteJob` operation.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 100 per user. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
